answer: When a beacon proves that k bonded identities equivocated in coordination, pairwise culpability creates O(k²) penalties, rather than a flat per-identity fine. Detection also applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier, such as a^k for a>1, through slashing and asymmetric depreciation of their escrows. Thus, a sybil swarm risks losses that ripple across its collateral; ferrous-sounding toughness cannot make coordinated fraud cheap.
